items.promise: Every data check runs before any modelling, and each finding is logged with the decision taken.
items.result: All 9 checks logged; 4 changed the analysis.

items.promise: The test term (2014J) is scored once, after the model and cut points are frozen.
items.result: Scored once, 3 days after the model was frozen.

items.promise: Week-4 differences are reported with effect sizes and Holm-corrected tests, not p-values alone.
items.result: Rank-biserial r = 0.41 for clicks; all tests reported with CIs.

items.promise: Calibration slope between 0.8 and 1.2 on the test term.
items.result: Slope 0.74: the model is overconfident at the top end.

items.promise: The simpler model wins unless the complex one is clearly better.
items.result: Logistic regression kept; boosting was within noise.

items.promise: Gender, age, disability and deprivation are never model inputs.
items.result: Excluded; adding them moved AUC by 0.003.

items.promise: Catch and false-alarm rates within 5 points between genders.
Catch and false-alarm rates within 5 points across age bands.
items.result: Largest gap 7.8 points (over-55s caught less often).

Catch and false-alarm rates within 5 points across deprivation bands.
